app.subtitle: A multiplayer tabletop RPG for the 2024 fifth-edition rules
app.title: Dungeons of the Fifth Age
audio.room_help: Plays for everyone while the party is here. Battle music replaces it during combat.
bestiary.drag_help: Drag a monster onto the map to place it, double-click to use the Spawn tool, or click to preview.
bestiary.legal: Monster statistics come from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (CC BY 4.0). ★ marks your own homebrew creatures.
bestiary.pick: Select a monster to see its stat block.
bestiary.place_help: Then click a free cell on the map (right-click to stop).
bestiary.title: Bestiary
cast.click_direction: Click a cell to aim (the area starts at the caster).
cast.click_point: Click the point of origin on the map.
cast.click_point_or_creature: Click a creature or a point on the map.
combat.choose_target: Click a target on the map (right-click cancels)
combat.title: Combat
creator.class_note: Classes, hit dice and saving throws follow SRD 5.2.1 (2024 rules). Class features beyond level 1 combat basics are listed in the rules coverage matrix.
creator.name: Name
creator.portrait_invalid: That file isn't a valid PNG under 4 MB.
creator.rolled_note: Rolled scores will be rolled by the host (coming soon) so nobody can fake them.
custom.help: Custom monsters are saved with this campaign and appear in the bestiary with ★.
custom.name: Name
custom.title: Custom monster
dialogue.dm_note: Players choose; you see the same window.
dialogue.title: Dialogue
dice.title: Dice
draw.help: Left-drag on the map to draw. Right-click to stop drawing.
draw.title: Draw
editor.art_status_help: Every tile, object and icon is generated by the game itself; no third-party images are used. Asset packs with their own licenses can be added later.
editor.collision_overlay: Show collision (✖ blocks movement, □ blocks sight, • difficult)
editor.favorites_help: Right-click an asset to add or remove it from favorites.
editor.inspector_help: Select objects (tool 1) to edit their properties here.
editor.preview: Preview: hide the editor and see the map as it plays
editor.tool_hint: Editing — right-click to return to Play
effects.title: Active effects
events.help: Events run automatically: WHEN something happens, THEN do these actions. No code needed.
events.name: Name
events.picking: Click on the map… (for an area: first corner, then second corner)
events.speaker: Speaker
events.title: Scripted events
events.trigger_manual: Only when the DM fires it
feature.inspiration_help: Click to use your Bardic Inspiration die on your next failed d20 roll.
form.invite_ok: ✔ Invite link recognised — the session code is included.
form.join_help: Paste the invite link from your DM (dnd55://…). Or type the DM's address (IP:port) and the session code.
form.port_help: Players connect to your IP address and this port. Over the internet they need port forwarding or a private network (e.g. Tailscale); a relay service is planned.
game.no_character: You don't have a character in this campaign yet.
graph.arrange: Arrange automatically (by distance from the party)
graph.edge_help: Click: delete this connection · Right-click: lock/unlock
graph.help: Drag rooms to arrange them · click a room to view/edit it · right-click for travel, links and delete · double-click empty space for a new room. Only the DM can move the party.
graph.how_1: • Click a room to preview it; double-click to edit its map.
graph.how_2: • Drag the gold ◆ on a room's right edge onto another room to connect them.
graph.how_3: • Click a connection to make it one-way, locked or secret.
graph.how_4: • Drag empty space to pan, wheel to zoom; Fit / Center / Arrange in the toolbar.
graph.how_5: • Only you see this map. The party moves only when you confirm.
graph.label: Label (e.g. Iron gate)
graph.name: Name
graph.route_locked: The passage is locked. Travel anyway as DM override?
graph.route_none: These rooms are not connected. Travel anyway as DM override?
graph.route_ok: There is an open passage: the party can travel.
graph.secret_room: Secret room (hidden from players until visited)
graph.title: Campaign map
inv.administer: Give the potion to this ally (Bonus Action, 5 ft)
inv.help: Equipment changes happen outside combat. Potions take a Bonus Action. You can give items to allies within 5 ft.
inv.title: Inventory
invite.direct_help: Direct internet play needs TCP port forwarding on your router to this computer (or UPnP). Port:
invite.intro: Send one of these links to your players. They paste it into Join ▶ Invite link.
invite.online_help: A relay server forwards traffic so nobody needs to open ports. You need the address of a running dnd55-relay (see the installation guide).
invite.online_title: Play over the internet with a relay
invite.security: Only people with the session code can join. The DM-only tools never reach players. Close the game or restart hosting to invalidate old invites.
invite.title: Invite players
invite.upnp_help: Asks your router to open the port. Many routers disable UPnP; the relay works without it.
invite.upnp_ok: Router opened the port. Public address:
level.asi: Ability Score Improvement (+2 to one or +1 to two, max 20)
level.help: The host checks every choice against the rules; if something is missing you'll get a message.
lobby.ready_help: Tells the DM you are ready to start.
log.title: Adventure Log
menu.title: Main Menu
monsters.help: Select a monster, then click the map to place it.
party.title: Party
props.contents_help: Players see the contents after the object is opened and can take items when adjacent.
props.label: Label
props.title: Object properties
reaction.deflect_help: Reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dex + Monk level.
reaction.hit_title: You are hit! Use a reaction?
reaction.shield_help: +5 AC until the start of your next turn, possibly turning this hit into a miss. Uses a level 1+ spell slot.
reaction.title: Opportunity Attack
reaction.uncanny_dodge_help: Halve the attack's damage against you.
rest.long_help: 8 hours: characters with at least 1 HP regain all HP, spell slots, all spent Hit Dice and long-rest features; Exhaustion drops by 1.
rest.short_help: 1 hour: characters may spend Hit Dice; short-rest features recharge.
rest.spend_hit_die_help: During a Short Rest: roll one Hit Die + Constitution modifier and regain that many HP.
rest.title: Rest & rewards
select.help: Click an object to select · Shift+click to add · drag empty space for a box · drag a selected object to move · Ctrl+C/V/D, Del, R, Esc, Ctrl+Z/Y.
select.title: Selection
session.free_movement: Players may move freely outside combat
session.teleport_help: Shift+click on the map moves the selected creature without rules (DM override).
settings.no_audio_device: No audio device was found: DND55 is running without sound.
settings.reduced_motion_help: Fewer animations (menu scene, water, particles, transitions)
settings.restart_needed: Restart DND55 to apply the graphics backend.
settings.vsync_help: Sync to monitor refresh (smooth, saves power)
sheet.click_attack: Click, then click a target on the map
sheet.spells_pending: Spellcasting is not implemented yet (see the rules coverage matrix).
sheet.title: Character Sheet
spell.none_prepared: No spells prepared yet — open the Prepare tab.
spell.prepare_help: You can change prepared spells after a Long Rest. Spells are from the SRD 5.2.1.
spell.prepare_outside_combat: Prepared spells can't be changed during combat.
spell.upcast_help: Cast with a slot of this level (higher slots strengthen many spells).
weather.title: Atmosphere
xp.award_help: Gives this XP to every party character. Characters level up from their sheet.
xp.milestone_help: Lets the selected character level up without XP.
